rules.claim: 響 immediately before the suffix lemma めく selects どよ; UniDic 2.1.2 lacks the 響めく orthography.
constraints: next token POS1 is 接尾辞
next token lemma is めく
negativeConstraints: standalone 響/響く/響き keep dictionary readings
rules.title: 響+めく reads どよ

rules.claim: Bare pronoun 私 selects わたし over UniDic's formal わたくし; sung register.
constraints: token POS1 is 代名詞
negativeConstraints: 私立 and other compounds keep dictionary readings
rules.title: Pronoun 私 reads わたし

rules.claim: Independent-pronoun or boundary-separated 君 selects きみ; 君 attached to a person name as a suffix keeps くん.
constraints: pronoun POS, or an authored/provider boundary separates 君 from the previous token
suffix reading requires attached person-name context
negativeConstraints: never a surface-wide 君 override
田中君-style honorifics keep くん
rules.title: 君: independent pronoun きみ vs honorific suffix くん

rules.claim: 方 read かた as suffix/noun directly after a pronoun selects rendaku がた (あなた方).
constraints: previous token POS1 is 代名詞
token POS1 is 接尾辞 or 名詞
dictionary reading is かた
negativeConstraints: demonstrative この方 keeps かた
rules.title: Pronoun+方 rendaku がた

rules.claim: 何 followed by a registered counter or copular construction reads なん; 何 followed by a case particle (が/を/に/から) as an independent pronoun reads なに. Unreviewed collisions abstain to the analyzer reading.
constraints: decision uses the following token's role, never the surface alone
counter path requires a registered counter or copula
pronoun path requires case-particle attachment
negativeConstraints: lexicalized 何でも/何か/何も keep analyzer readings
何と何-style collisions abstain
rules.title: 何: なん in counter/copular constructions, なに as case-marked pronoun

rules.claim: 時 after a finite clause or determiner reads とき; 時 directly after a bounded numeric/interrogative clock expression reads じ. Compounds (時計/時代/一時的) stay analyzer-owned.
constraints: counter path requires an adjacent numeric or interrogative-numeric expression
temporal path requires clause/determiner context
rule never crosses an authored hard boundary
negativeConstraints: 時計/時代 and lexical 一時 keep analyzer readings
rules.title: 時: temporal noun とき vs clock counter じ

rules.claim: Hours 0-24 attached to 時 read with standard allomorphs: 4→よ, 7→しち, 9→く, 0→れい; Arabic, full-width, and conventional Kanji numerals are equivalent after NFKC.
constraints: value is an integer 0-24
counter surface is 時 in clock use
negativeConstraints: no decimals/ranges/identifiers
四六時中 and lexical 一時 excluded
rules.title: Bounded clock-hour readings

rules.claim: 1人/一人 reads ひとり and 2人/二人 reads ふたり; from three onward Sino-Japanese readings stay analyzer-owned.
constraints: value is exactly 1 or 2
counter surface is 人 in count use
negativeConstraints: 3人+ keeps analyzer reading
人 as nationality suffix じん untouched
rules.title: Native one/two-person counts

rules.claim: Independent 雨 immediately following the authored weather-transition expression のち selects あめ when UniDic fragments のち雨 as symbols.
constraints: canonical text immediately before 雨 ends with the hiragana expression のち
雨 is a separate occurrence rather than part of a lexical compound
no hard boundary separates のち and 雨
negativeConstraints: never applies to compound-internal 雨
雨雲/雨宿り/大雨/小雨/豪雨/雷雨/梅雨/春雨 remain analyzer-owned
standalone noun 雨 already read あめ remains a keep case
rules.title: Weather construction のち雨 reads あめ

rules.claim: Split 一+歩 with readings いち+ほ finalizes as いっ+ぽ before romaji derivation.
constraints: adjacent tokens 一(いち) and 歩(ほ)
rules.title: 一歩 reads いっぽ

rules.claim: 一(いち) directly before a K-row reading finalizes as いっ with gemination (一回→いっかい).
constraints: next selected reading starts with a K-row kana
rules.title: 一 before K-row geminates

rules.claim: Only an analyzer-observed failed split of numeral 一(いち) plus a reviewed S/T/CH/H counter or following morpheme finalizes as いっ; entries may also declare a bounded H-row→P-row alternation.
constraints: left token is numeral 一 with selected reading いち
right token matches a reviewed surface/lemma/POS/reading-class entry
the analyzer did not already emit a correct lexicalized/allomorphic reading
tokens are adjacent and no hard boundary separates them
negativeConstraints: never applies from initial consonant alone
never rewrites an analyzer-correct single token or already-correct split reading
native and lexicalized 一 forms remain analyzer-owned
voiced and sonorant followers remain いち/ひと as supplied by the analyzer
rules.title: 一 before reviewed counter/allomorph classes geminates

rules.claim: A token-final っ geminates the next token's initial consonant (言っ+て→itte) during kana finalization.
constraints: previous selected reading ends with っ
next selected reading starts with a consonant
no hard boundary separates the tokens
negativeConstraints: punctuation and other hard boundaries block cross-token gemination
rules.title: Cross-token sokuon gemination

rules.claim: An exact all-kanji common-noun token may replace UniDic's formal reading with a unique prioritized JMdict reading marked usually written in kana; compound context abstains.
constraints: exact token is an all-kanji common noun of at least two code points
JMdict has exactly one prioritized reading across entries for the written surface
a sense for that reading is marked usually written using kana
JmdictFurigana confirms the exact surface+reading pair
productive rules and validated provider evidence remain higher priority
negativeConstraints: no first-reading-wins behavior
left-adjacent noun/prefix compounds remain analyzer-owned
ambiguous or unprioritized readings abstain
rules.title: Uniquely preferred usually-kana lexical readings

rules.claim: Unresolved lexical ambiguity for 明日 defaults to あした in lyric register; validated provider evidence may select another known candidate (あす) but no runtime evidence source ships in this migration.
constraints: applies only when structural context and provider evidence leave the ambiguity unresolved
negativeConstraints: never invents readings outside the candidate set {あした, あす, みょうにち}
rules.title: 明日 defaults to あした
